% Invented text. A quotation on a slide: the same IR node the article
% carries, so both backends set it off without a slides special case.
\documentclass{slides}

\begin{document}

\begin{frame}{An Invented Epigraph}
Before the quotation, at the frame's full measure.
\begin{quote}
Typesetting is invisible until it fails, said no real person here.
\end{quote}
After the quotation, back at the full measure.
\end{frame}

\end{document}
